checkRuns.command:
pkill -f ".output/server" ; bun run check 2>&1 | tail; bun run build 2>&1 | grep -i "error" ; (PORT=3457 bun run start > /tmp/srv.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 2
ID=$(curl -s localhost:3457/contact | grep -o 'action="[^"]*"' | cut -d'"' -f2); echo $ID
curl -s -i -X POST "localhost:3457$ID" --data-urlencode 'name= ' --data-urlencode 'email=bad' --data-urlencode 'message=short' -c /tmp/cj | grep -i "^HTTP\|location"
curl -s -b /tmp/cj localhost:3457/contact | grep -o '<form.*</form>'

bun run check 2>&1 | tail; bun run build 2>&1 | grep -i "error"; (PORT=3457 bun run start > /tmp/srv.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 2
ID=$(curl -s localhost:3457/contact | grep -o 'action="[^"]*"' | cut -d'"' -f2); echo $ID
curl -s -i -X POST "localhost:3457$ID" --data-urlencode 'name= ' --data-urlencode 'email=bad' --data-urlencode 'message=short' -c /tmp/cj | grep -i "^HTTP\|location"
sed -i 's/#HttpOnly_//' /tmp/cj; sed -i 's/TRUE\tTRUE/TRUE\tFALSE/' /tmp/cj; cat /tmp/cj | cut -c1-80

pkill -f "output/server/index" ; bun remove playwright-core 2>&1 | tail -1; git status --short; bun run check 2>&1 | tail -3 && bun run build 2>&1 | tail -2; sleep 1; (PORT=3458 bun run start >/dev/null 2>&1 &); sleep 2; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" localhost:3458/; pkill -f "output/server/index"; sleep 1; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" localhost:3458/ localhost:3457/
pkill -f "[o]utput/server/index"; bun remove playwright-core 2>&1 | tail -1; git status --short; bun run check 2>&1 | tail -3 && bun run build 2>&1 | tail -2

docs.source: https://docs.solidjs.com/llms.txt and the pages it links
